description.label: Description
description.value:
Minor Mental Mutation

Mundane pleasures no longer excite you and you can only receive titillation if you inflict or receive injuries. Whenever you deal or take 1 Wound you gain +5 Strength, Toughness and Willpower for 1d10 Rounds. You gain access to the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.hXcfygzujgyMN1uI]{Frenzy} Talent while under the effect. If you start frenzying it won’t stop when the 1d10 duration of this mutation ends. Follow the normal rules instead. You may inflict a Wound on yourself to gain this modifier. The bonus does not stack, but new Wounds after the duration will renew the effect. Wounds from other mutations, like @UUID[Compendium.artantares-mutations.items.Item.XdbHWsUa59sLvLkN]{Unhealing Wound}, do not activate this mutation.
